english: A ruler unfolds.
Gail sees a stream.
The bridge is not done.
The plank is too short.
Gail stays back.
How wide is the stream?
How long is the plank?
The lengths do not match.
Let's make a model.
This plank bends.
A support helps.
An arch helps too.
Check this join.
They have a plan.
This plank can reach.
Adults build the bridge.
The builder tests it.
They cross the bridge.
Time to go home.
Gail is home.
chinese: 尺子展開了。
瑜瑜看見小溪。
橋還沒搭好。
木板太短了。
瑜瑜留在岸邊。
小溪有多寬？
木板有多長？
兩個長度不同。
來做模型吧。
這塊板彎了。
支柱有幫助。
橋拱也有幫助。
檢查這個接點。
他們有計畫了。
這塊板跨得過去。
大人搭橋。
工匠先測試。
他們過橋了。
該回家了。
瑜瑜回家了。

english: A folding ruler glows on Gail's floor. It opens like a little door.
The ruler's light stretches across the room. Gail sees a stream through it.
Gail meets the builder by a small stream. The bridge is not ready to cross.
One plank ends before the other bank. A gap is easy to see.
Gail and her friends stay in the safe area. The builders stop work to check.
The builder measures between the two supports. Gail watches the number on the ruler.
They measure the plank too. It is shorter than the space it must cross.
Gail puts two colored strips side by side. One is shorter.
The builder gives Gail a little bridge model. They can test ideas on the table.
A thin model plank bends under a small weight. Gail sees it needs support.
They put a support under the model. The plank bends less.
The model has an arch. Gail sees how its shape holds the top.
Gail points to a loose joint on the model. The builder connects it again.
The builders choose a longer plank and strong supports. Gail shows them the model.
Adults bring a plank that reaches both supports. Gail stays back.
The builders fix the platform and bolts. Children wait behind the line.
An adult checks the level and steps on the bridge first. It feels steady.
The builder says the bridge is ready. Gail crosses with an adult.
The builder thanks Gail for comparing the lengths. Her ruler glows again.
Gail folds the ruler by her bed. She remembers to measure before building.
chinese: 折疊尺在瑜瑜的地板上發光，像小門一樣打開。
尺子的光穿過房間。瑜瑜從中看見小溪。
瑜瑜在小溪旁遇見工匠。橋還不能走。
一塊木板到不了對岸，缺口很清楚。
瑜瑜與朋友待在安全區。工匠停下來檢查。
工匠量兩個支座之間的距離。瑜瑜看著尺子。
他們也量木板。它比需要跨越的距離短。
瑜瑜把兩條彩帶並排。一條比較短。
工匠給瑜瑜一個小橋模型。他們能在桌上試想法。
薄模型木板在小重物下彎曲。瑜瑜看見它需要支撐。
他們在模型下加支柱，木板彎得比較少。
模型有橋拱。瑜瑜看見這個形狀如何撐住上方。
瑜瑜指出模型鬆開的接點。工匠把它重新接好。
工匠選擇較長木板與穩固支柱。瑜瑜展示模型。
大人搬來能跨到兩側支座的木板。瑜瑜留在後方。
工匠固定橋面與螺栓。孩子們在線後等待。
大人檢查水平並先走上橋，橋很穩。
工匠說橋可以走了。瑜瑜和大人一起過橋。
工匠謝謝瑜瑜比較長度。她的尺又發光了。
瑜瑜把尺放在床邊。她記得搭建前先測量。

english: In Gail's familiar bedroom, a folding ruler begins to glow. Its sections unfold slowly and make a bright outline on the floor.
Light travels from the ruler across the bedroom floor before a doorway opens. Gail sees a shallow stream and an unfinished bridge beyond it.
At the stream, Gail meets an adult builder beside an unfinished footbridge. Everyone waits on the shore because the crossing is not ready.
A wooden plank stops before it reaches the support on the far bank. The visible gap shows why no one should step onto the bridge yet.
Gail stays with the other children behind the marked work area. The builders pause instead of trying to cover the gap by guesswork.
The builder stretches a tape between the two bridge supports and measures the full span. Gail watches where the tape begins and ends.
They then measure the plank from one end to the other. Its length is shorter than the distance between the supports, confirming the problem.
Gail uses colored strips on a table to compare the measured span and plank length. Their ends do not line up, so the difference is easy to see.
The builder brings a small bridge model to the worktable. Testing a model lets Gail see possible changes without touching the real construction.
When they set a small weight at the center, the thin model plank bends. Gail sees that reaching across is only one part of making a sturdy bridge.
Gail adds a support beneath the model's center while the builder watches. With the same weight, the plank bends less than before.
The builder shows how a small arch can carry weight toward both sides of the model base. Gail compares this shape with the straight plank they first tested.
One model joint slips when they lift the bridge. Gail points it out, and the builder helps connect the pieces before another test.
The builders plan a correctly sized platform with sturdy supports and secure joints. Gail uses the model to show which measurements they checked.
The adults bring a plank of the measured length to the bridge site. It spans both supports while Gail watches from the safe area.
Adult builders fasten the platform and its bolts, then check each joint. The children remain behind the marked work line during construction.
Before inviting anyone across, the builder checks that the bridge is level and tests its support. The finished platform stays steady under his steps.
After the builder says the bridge is ready, Gail walks across with an adult. She can see the stream safely flowing beneath the new platform.
The builder thanks Gail for helping compare the lengths and test the model. The folding ruler glows and opens the route back to her bedroom.
Back in her familiar bedroom, Gail folds the ruler and sets it beside her bed. She remembers to measure, make a model, and revise a plan before building.
chinese: 在瑜瑜熟悉的臥室，一把折疊尺開始發光。尺節慢慢展開，在地板上畫出亮亮的輪廓。
光從尺子沿著臥室地板延伸，接著才打開入口。瑜瑜看見一條淺溪和一座搭建中的橋。
瑜瑜在小溪旁遇見一位成年工匠。行人橋還沒完工，大家都留在岸邊等待。
一塊木板還沒碰到對岸支座就停住了。明顯的缺口讓大家知道目前不能上橋。
瑜瑜和其他孩子待在標示的工作區外。工匠暫停施工，沒有憑猜測掩蓋缺口。
工匠把量尺拉到橋的兩個支座之間，量出完整跨距。瑜瑜觀察尺子從哪裡開始、在哪裡結束。
接著他們量木板從一端到另一端的長度。木板短於兩個支座之間的距離，問題因此確定。
瑜瑜在桌上用兩條彩帶比較量得的跨距與木板長度。兩端沒有對齊，差距很清楚。
工匠拿來一個小橋模型。先測試模型，瑜瑜就能看見不同改法，而不用碰真正的工地。
他們把小重物放在中央時，薄薄的模型木板彎了。瑜瑜發現，跨得過去只是穩固橋梁的一部分。
工匠在旁看著，瑜瑜在模型中央下方加上支柱。同樣的重量放上去，木板比剛才彎得少。
工匠示範小橋拱如何把重量帶向模型底座兩端。瑜瑜拿它和最初測試的直木板比較。
他們抬起模型時，一處接點滑開了。瑜瑜指出問題，工匠幫忙把兩塊連好才再測試。
工匠計畫使用尺寸正確的橋面、穩固支柱與牢靠接點。瑜瑜用模型指出他們核對過的測量結果。
大人把依量測長度準備的木板送到橋邊。它跨到兩側支座，瑜瑜在安全區觀看。
成年工匠固定橋面與螺栓，再檢查每個接點。施工時孩子們始終留在標示的工作線後。
工匠邀請其他人過橋前，先檢查橋面是否平整並測試支撐。他走上去時，完工橋面保持穩固。
工匠確認橋已可通行後，瑜瑜才和大人一起走過。她看見溪水安全地從新橋面下方流過。
工匠謝謝瑜瑜協助比較長度、測試模型。折疊尺發光，打開回臥室的路。
回到熟悉臥室，瑜瑜把尺折好放在床邊。她記得搭建前先測量、做模型，並修正計畫。
